caption:
One short dua that covers this life and the next

Allah mentions people who ask Him for good in this world, good in the Hereafter, and protection from the Fire. Short enough to learn tonight, and to say every day.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:201

Teach this dua to someone you love

#rabbanaatina #duaoftheday #hereafter #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
alt_text: And there are others who say, “Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqara 2:201)
